records.field: PDF p.497, printed p.484; 愛(爱) entry; attached source scan pixels inspected
records.text: The printed headword is 愛(爱). The entry says 愛 developed from 㤅, quotes 說文 as 愛，行皃。从夂，㤅聲, and separately quotes 㤅，惠也。从心，旡聲. It reports Guodian 老子甲 “甚㤅(爱)必大費” and says 㤅 is used there like 愛. The scan reads 皃 after 行, not 兒; the p.498 scan begins 夏 and does not continue the 愛 entry. These are the book’s reports, not an independent reading of the cited artifacts or a precise date for 愛’s affection sense.
